chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Seeing the Henderson band in Ohio and Buster Bailey
summary: He always went to see the Henderson band in Ohio because he and Buster Bailey were pals.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you see the Henderson band...
Yes. They used to come out in Ohio. I'd always go to see them. Because Buster and I were kind of pals, you know.
Yeah, you were friends a long time.
Where did you first meet him?
I don't know. I suppose it was... It could have been Cincinnati. It could have been... I don't know. I really don't remember.
